whereMoneyGoes.title: Behind the scenes: where does your subscription go?
whereMoneyGoes.body: Transparency matters to me: the app doesn't collect or sell your data. Automatic cloud sync and full backup of all your recipes require maintaining cloud databases, and their cost grows with the number of users and the traffic.
